requirements.title: Research Agent Spawn API
requirements.description: POST /api/v1/backlog/{kind}/{name}/research endpoint with prompt-manager skill resolution and agent-manager spawning

validation.notes: Research endpoint resolves prompt skill by kind+mode, spawns agent via agent-manager
Fallback prompt used when prompt-manager unavailable

requirements.title: Research Agent Dialog Interface
requirements.description: Backlog agent dialog with agent-mode selection (workshop / initialize) plus a multi-turn clarification Q&A panel for refining workshop decisions. The standalone suggestions accept/reject panel was removed in the 2026-03 research backlog rework in favor of the workshop-based refinement flow (see OT-P1-004 'Implemented (workshop-based refinement flow)').

validation.notes: backlog-agent-dialog renders the agent-mode selector with context input
clarification-panel displays the multi-turn Q&A thread

validation.ref: ui/src/components/backlog/clarification-panel.test.tsx::textarea is disabled while isLoading is true
validation.notes: clarification-panel collects operator responses via its input textarea
